thread:
morgan.design: Dropped a new compact Alerting preview prototype — focus on ordering of notification channels, preview indicator states, and keyboard affordances. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/NEWPREVIEW (frame: compact-preview-ordering)

taylor.pm: Looks crisp. Two quick points: 1) ordering in the preview should match the send order (urgent > email > slack). 2) tiny indicator to show which channel will fire first?

morgan.design: Agreed on order mapping. I added a small numeric badge "1/2/3" to the left of each channel in the preview to indicate send order — subtle, 10px.

jules.eng: Numeric badges fine, but we need to ensure they don't collapse the row on narrow widths. Suggest turning them into visually-hidden read order for SRs and keep visual numbers only above 320px.

samira.a11y: For screen readers announce send order when preview opens: "Channel preview opened. 1: PagerDuty (primary), 2: Slack, 3: Email." Use `aria-live="polite"` and ensure the text is updated after mount (see pattern below).

leo.product: Copy tweak: instead of "send order" label, try "notification sequence" in the preview header — slightly clearer for non-ops users.

morgan.design: Updated microcopy in figma to "Notification sequence" and added a tooltip: "Order notifications will be sent when an incident triggers."

jules.eng: Implementation note: render preview in a root-level portal so it won't be clipped by the sidebar. Also support keyboard shortcut `k` when the row has focus to open the preview for power users.

samira.a11y: Keyboard shortcut is great — but ensure a discoverable hint (tooltip + `aria-keyshortcuts="k"`) and a way to remap/disable for users. Also, when opened via shortcut announce the same live region text after sR-friendly delay.

morgan.design: Good call. I'll add a small keyboard hint (icon + "k") that is visually hidden on compact mobile. Mobile fallback should open the inline pill instead of the panel.

jules.eng: For the `aria-live` pattern, we recommend mount -> RAF -> setTimeout(50) -> update live region. Example for handoff:

```
// overlay mount
requestAnimationFrame(() => setTimeout(() => {
  liveRegion.textContent = `Notification preview: 1 ${primaryName}, 2 ${secondaryName}`;
}, 60));
```

samira.a11y: Perfect. Also check contrast on the numeric badges — the design token I see is bg #EEF3FF / fg #374151 which should meet AA at 10px. If using 10px we need to test in high-dpi.

morgan.design: I'll switch the badge FG to #111827 for extra headroom and add token `preview.badge.fg` so dev can tweak.

leo.product: UX question: if a user toggles suppression from the preview, do we change the sequence order indicator (if a channel is silenced) or just gray it out?

jules.eng: Gray out the row with a small muted badge "silenced" and keep numeric positions static. Recomputing order on the fly gets messy and surprising. Add undo snackbar for accidental silences.

samira.a11y: When row is grayed, ensure the SR sees a clear announcement: "Slack channel silenced" and include focusable Undo in the toast with `role=\"status\"`. Add test scenario in the a11y checklist.

morgan.design: I'll add the muted badge state in the frames + a short animation spec for the gray transition (prefers reduced-motion fallback).

deploy-bot: deploy:preview rendered preview component on staging for QA -> /staging/preview-compact (build 2026.03.23) :rocket:

leo.product: Nice. QA, please smoke test keyboard open (`Enter`/`k`), portal rendering, and the aria-live announcement timing.

jules.eng: We'll wire up data-testid attributes: `preview-open-btn`, `preview-badge`, `preview-silence-toggle` for e2e and accessibility smoke tests.

samira.a11y: I'll run SR + keyboard-only passes once staging is up. Also will add a tiny checklist item: ensure `aria-hidden` is not set on the live region container.

morgan.design: Thanks — final handoff will include token names, the RAF+60ms snippet, keyboard shortcut hint, portal note, reduced-motion flag, and copy variants ("Notification sequence" vs "Send order") for the usability run. Will push by EOD.
